sn35.10:1.3: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītesu rūpesu anapekho hoti,
sn35.10:1.5: paccuppannānaṃ rūpānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn35.10:1.12: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītesu dhammesu anapekho hoti,
sn35.10:1.14: paccuppannānaṃ dhammānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotīti.
